proof_basis: GitHub required status checks must pass before a protected-branch PR can merge.
GitHub branch protection can pin a required status check to a specific GitHub App; checks from another user or integration do not satisfy it.

The GitHub Checks API write surface is available only to GitHub Apps. Repository Actions uses the generic github-actions App id 15368, so the required check must instead be pinned to a dedicated external App whose installation token is outside repository Actions and shared owner runtime.
GitHub branch protection must be configured to apply to administrators to remove the shared owner/admin bypass.
Repository auto-merge must be disabled to block UI/GraphQL auto-merge creation rather than merely waiting to block finalization.
scripts/git/canonical_review_check.py protection-plan requires a successful external-App canary and rejects github-actions id 15368, slug github-actions, or an App owned by ajoe734.

scripts/git/canonical_review_check.py verify-protection requires that retained machine plan and returns success only when the dedicated App-pinned check and both remaining boundary controls are present, strict is unchanged, and the full pre-existing context/app_id multiset is preserved.
